title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
sizeless builds the data layer for physical AI in construction. Contractors film an open trench with a smartphone. Our system turns that video into a 3D model, recognises what is in the ground, and delivers the documentation the industry needs – CAD, BIM, GIS and quantities. The same data is the foundation for training the robots that will one day work on construction sites.
 It is a real problem with real customers: construction and utilities still document reality by hand, and almost nothing about that process has changed in decades. We are a small team with research experience from ETH Zurich, UC Berkeley and MIT, and we are looking for an engineer who wants to bring this technology onto real construction sites and make it work for our customers.
 Tasks Work directly with our customers – contractors, utilities and surveyors in Switzerland, Germany and Austria – from first site visit to daily use
 Get field crews up and running with our capture app, on site and remotely
 Adapt our outputs to each customer's CAD, GIS and documentation standards
 Write the scripts, integrations and tooling that connect sizeless to customer systems
 Bring what you learn on site back into the product, together with the engineering team
 Requirements Solid engineering fundamentals in TypeScript, Python or a comparable language
 You enjoy working with customers and are comfortable on a construction site
 Ownership: you take problems personally and see them through
 Fluent German and English – most of our customers work in German
 Willingness to travel regularly within Switzerland, Germany and Austria and valid driving licence (category B)
 Experience with 3D data, mobile apps or geospatial systems is welcome. We care more that you learn quickly and take details seriously.
 Benefits Early team member with real ownership – your work ships to paying customers, not a demo
 Employee stock options: you own part of what you build
 New office in Zürich Kreis 5
